other_screened_sources.name: Walker et al. 2016
other_screened_sources.status: Two active arms assessed at 0, 5 and 10 training weeks. Published means and SD of individual percentage changes extracted for the full interval. No raw trajectories obtained or tendon endpoint.

other_screened_sources.name: Pürzel et al. 2025
other_screened_sources.status: Seven published DOCX supplements inspected. S1–S5 describe waveforms, EMG/model comparisons, simulation and segmentation; S6 is aggregate joint force contrast. S7 lists mass-normalized and absolute squat 1RM by participant. No matching raw geometry, two-angle maximal isometric leg-press force or local tendon endpoint.

other_screened_sources.name: Bontemps et al.
other_screened_sources.status: Weeks 0, 2, 4 for knee torque and patellar tendon. Institutional record has the manuscript with group aggregates; no training comparison group.

other_screened_sources.name: Temporal coordination and volume of cyclic mechanical loading
other_screened_sources.status: Weeks 0, 8, 16 for plantarflexor strength and tendon. Source data available by request, published supplement consists of group-level summaries.

other_screened_sources.name: Weerasekera et al.
other_screened_sources.status: Randomized strength data; participant files available by request. No corresponding tissue strength measurement.

other_screened_sources.name: Zoger et al.
other_screened_sources.status: Bilateral isometric comparator identified in EXP-0129; published raw access on request.

other_screened_sources.name: Scherpereel / OpenCap
other_screened_sources.status: Existing program audit. Dynamic squat kinematics are not independent maximal isometric force at matched leg press positions.
